rezumat: Milestones A (safe incremental collection), B (INS), C (12 entries), D (meanings and shared groups) and E (preview, coverage, report) are complete.

Structured field evidence now covers {with_fields} of {finder} projects and resources (baseline 14). The retained sources are {source_urls} URLs ({parsed} parsed, {failed} failed) with {field_records:,} field records.
Each field record is a path in a source. The proposals are {groups} shared groups (baseline 7), 16 provider review items and the dictionary evidence that `inventory.py --check` verifies.
The public build is unchanged: the default payload equals the v0.13.0 payload apart from its generation time; classifications and accepted providers are identical.
Collection used {direct_requests} direct requests in total ({browser_navigations} browser navigations); the 150-request limit of lot C was not reached.
Batch C2 (three active projects): 1 inventory with 10 sources, 2 entries blocked by HTTP 403, 3 proposed groups and provider items D176–D185; see the subsection of section 3.

limite: Doar tabele din paginile ediției și clasamentul județelor; căutarea de localități nu încarcă date (mod demonstrație).
Tipurile sunt observate din cel mult cinci rânduri.
afacut.blocaj: Nu există un set de date pe localități în paginile citite: căutarea spune „Mod demonstrație”.
afacut.urmatorul_pas: Căutați seturile data.gov.ro ale MDLPA citate în pagină și verificați paginile pe localități.
afacut.rezultat: Describes public money for roads, water and sewer, and gas networks: the national reporting steps (date, step and cumulative amount, in billions of lei) and a county ranking (amount per 100 lei allocated, allocated and requested amounts in millions of lei, localities with requests as "x din y"). Every unit comes from a table header. The search page loads no data and says that it runs in demonstration mode, so no locality-level dataset was found. The locality search is an HTML control candidate, not an accepted input.
afacut.limite_en: Tables of the edition and county pages only; types come from at most five rows; no locality dataset.
afacut.urmator_en: Find the MDLPA data.gov.ro datasets that the pages cite; check whether locality pages exist.

limite: 38 de serii INS în tabelul de documentație; valorile nu sunt citite.
Metadatele INS vin din oglinda ins.gov2.ro, care se oprește mai devreme decât cifrele proiectului.
biografia-localitatii.urmatorul_pas: Citiți metadatele celorlalte matrici din tabel și paginile pe localități.
biografia-localitatii.rezultat: Describes statistical biographies of 3,181 localities built from INS TEMPO series. The methodology page has a dictionary table of the series it uses (matrix, domain, what it measures, years, unit, update date). Metadata for three of those matrices (LOC101B, POP107D, GOS104A) is attached, each with the sentence of the table that names it. The projects' own values are not published as data in the pages read.
biografia-localitatii.limite_en: The dictionary table lists 37 matrices; metadata was read for three. The ins.gov2.ro mirror ends earlier than the years the project cites.
biografia-localitatii.urmator_en: Read the metadata of the other matrices; look for locality pages that expose series.

The API page lists 23 response items in five groups: identification, contact, fiscal status, activity and financial figures. The API needs a free key, which was not requested, so types and example values are unknown. limite: 10 din 84 de patch-uri SQL citite; schema este parțială.
Constantele din Statement.php sunt coduri, nu tabele.

dignitas.rezultat: Collaborative fact-checking platform. Ten repository files at commit c865254 (2026-03-13): nine SQL patches that create or alter tables such as entity, statement, relation, vote and tag, and the Statement class, whose constants define the statement types (claim, flop, promise) and the verdict scale. The repository link is the one that the profiler found on the project site.
dignitas.limite_en: 74 of 84 patches are unread, so the table list is partial. Constants give codes, not columns.
dignitas.urmator_en: Read the remaining patches or a current schema dump; confirm the live verdict scale.

limite: Documentele de proiectare dau forme de exemplu, nu un contract.

monitorul-ai.urmatorul_pas: Citiți schema canonică JSON, dacă este publică, și eșantioane din arhivă prin site.
monitorul-ai.rezultat: Public archive of Romanian parliamentary stenograms (Monitorul Oficial, Part II). Two design documents show the record shapes: a document envelope, session metadata, agenda items, speeches, votes with counts for, against and abstaining, speaker identity (name, title, role, party group, person id) and source spans. Four JSON Schemas describe the discourse-analysis outputs. The MCP guide lists the tools that the archive exposes.

monitorul-ai.urmator_en: Find a canonical JSON schema if one is public; sample the archive through the site.

Paginile locale/ și harta-notelor/ au peste 2.000.000 de octeți: s-au păstrat primii 600.000 de octeți, care se opresc înaintea scriptului cu date.
Câmpurile din scripturile paginilor sunt observate în eșantion (cel mult 25 de elemente); numele scurte (L, T, V, t, b, x) nu sunt descrise de pagini.
romania-interactiva.blocaj: Datele paginilor locale/ și harta-notelor/ nu au fost citite: răspunsurile depășesc 2.000.000 de octeți. Populația orașelor din Orașe digitale (câmpul pop) nu are sursă numită în pagină.
romania-interactiva.urmatorul_pas: Decideți dacă un răspuns de peste 2.000.000 de octeți poate fi citit întreg. Alegeți din cele 15 instrumente neinspectate (de exemplu 1vot.ro, geamanuleuropean.ro, sondajeleromaniei.ro, satulcaresestinge.ro). Hotărâți despre selectorii propuși pentru grupurile revizuite (vezi raportul).
romania-interactiva.rezultat: Platform of public tools by three lecturers of FSPAC, Babeș-Bolyai University: its home page lists 22 tools, six on the project host and the others on their own hosts. The pass read seven: the census tool (county population at eight censuses, 1948–2021), the governments timeline (28 governments), the university centres tool (students per centre and per university), the marriages and divorces map (counties, 1990–2024), the local elections map and the exam results map (both over 2,000,000 bytes, read as samples), and Orașe digitale (the e-government index of 325 cities). Each tool keeps its data in the page: script constants, a JSON data island and one HTML table. The new reader `js-literale` lists them with the types of a bounded sample; the JSON-LD `Dataset` of every page gives its name, period, licence and `isBasedOn`. Every page ends with a "Surse" or "Date" note that names its providers: INS (TEMPO matrices SCL103D, POP210A, POP212A, POP107A and census tables), Eurostat, CNFIS, AEP, the Ministry of Education (via data.gov.ro), Guvernul României, Monitorul Oficial and Agerpres; the dormitory data come from an ANOSR analysis and a Cushman & Wakefield Echinox study. Three INS matrices were read as metadata. Orașe digitale is the authors' own collection (manual coding of 46 indicators in five categories, three waves); the page names no source for the population of a city. The pages declare no field types, no units and no field descriptions, except six `variableMeasured` entries of Orașe digitale.
romania-interactiva.limite_en: Seven of 22 catalogue tools were read. Two pages are samples of 600,000 bytes (no data). Field records come from a bounded sample of script literals; short key names are not described by the pages.
romania-interactiva.urmator_en: Decide whether a response over 2,000,000 bytes may be read whole; choose more tools from the 15 that were not read (1vot.ro, geamanuleuropean.ro, sondajeleromaniei.ro, satulcaresestinge.ro); decide on the candidate selectors for the reviewed groups.
romania-interactiva.blocaj_en: The data of the local elections and exam results pages is beyond the 2,000,000-byte limit of the fetcher; the population of a city in Orașe digitale has no named source.

ins: Listing `https://ins.gov2.ro/api/datasets?limit=1`: HTTP 200, 557 bytes, `total` 3,368 datasets, 16 card members. The llms.txt file says "about 3,600". Only `limit=1` was run; `offset` is documented but unverified.

Five metadata records were read: ACC102B (available again, same body hash as on 2026-10-24), POP107D, LOC101B, TRN139A and GOS104A. The codes come from the pages of the projects that name them, and every use has an exact locator in the registry: POP107D (`constru-pentru-cine`, `orasul-care-se-intinde`, `demoanaf`), LOC101B (`constru-pentru-cine`, `orasul-care-se-intinde`, `biografia-localitatii`), TRN139A and GOS104A (`unde-se-termina-asfaltul`; GOS104A also `biografia-localitatii`).

Each record separates one indicator (the definition text), four to six dimensions and the dimension values, which appear only as samples of at most five codes with their labels. A dimension value is never a variable. Each dataset has one measure field `OBS_VALUE` whose declared unit comes from the unit dimension: persons (POP107D), number (LOC101B), kilometres (TRN139A, GOS104A). ACC102B declares two units (persons and per mille), so no single unit is chosen.

Misleading example: llms.txt presents `GET /api/datasets/ACC102B?lang=en` as "GDP". The record is workplace accidents (`CATEGORY`, `REF_AREA`, `TIME_PERIOD`, `UNIT_MEASURE`). Its source note names the Labour Inspectorate (Ministry of Labour); INS distribution alone does not prove authorship, so the proposal D160 is limited to that dataset and does not change the INS relation.
The `POP101A` example route of llms.txt was not re-measured. The 404 in the brief stays an unverified claim here.

Coverage differs between the mirror and the projects. LOC101B time options end in 2023 against 1990–2025 in `constru-pentru-cine`; POP107D ends in 2025 against 2026; TRN139A ends in 2024 against 2025. The projects read TEMPO directly; these records are metadata from the ins.gov2.ro mirror and are labelled so.

Locality dimension labels begin with a number (for example `38731 RIPICENI`). The POP107D note declares SIRUTA 38731 for Ripiceni and 98916 for Scânteia, and the options carry exactly those numbers, while a second Scânteia has 94429. This supports but does not prove that the leading token is SIRUTA for all localities; it stays an ambiguity note in `siruta`.

Company-level financial measures. A collection keyed by CUI (1,446 companies) is sampled as `{*}` records; no unit is declared.
Observed types for the mayoralty table that the CSV (headers only) cannot give.
How the weekly data checks are recorded.
The sources of the law texts (publisher, kind, audit date).
